title: agent-spawn launch --dry-run --json (also resume --dry-run)
description: Launch order step 1 only (usage checks, tool resolution, classification and pre-start checks 2 to 4 read-only, the window preflight), plus read-only lower-tool plans (resume --dry-run: resume steps 1 to 4); no hooks run and nothing is created; the liveness check only reports. Exit 20 exactly when would_refuse is set, else 0 (exits 2 and 12 print the error envelope).

reads_third_party.description: The classification: session_plan's profile.reads_third_party or taints.

session_plan.description: claude-session start [--resume [--fork]] --dry-run --json result (the classification dry run), verbatim (exit 0, 12 or 20 plan).

would_refuse.description: The refusal a real run would give (exit 20, plan still printed): launch: third_party_cwd, third_party_run, or claude-session's would_refuse; resume: also live or tearing_down (claude-session's would_refuse e.g. tainted); null: no refusal found. A dry run never takes a lease.

claude-session.description: Resolved argv of claude-session; null when not needed.

termctl.description: Resolved argv of termctl; null when not needed.

wtctl.description: Resolved argv of wtctl; null when not needed.

worktree_plan.description: wtctl create --dry-run --json result for --worktree new, verbatim; else null.

term_plan.description: termctl placements --json result when a window would be opened, verbatim; else null.

session_start_argv.description: The claude-session start argv that would run (never prompt text: prompts are shown as --prompt-file placeholders).

hooks.description: The agent-spawn hooks that would run (none is run by a dry run).
